data.name: Lightning Lord
data.description: You can call down %1 bolts of lightning per day. You can call down as many bolts as you want with a single standard action, but no creature can be the target of more than one bolt and no two targets can be more than 30 feet apart. This ability otherwise functions as Call Lightning.|WeatherLightningLordTimes
